Subject: DevTool Synergy + OpsConsult — pilot briefing series?

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the intro call last week. OpsConsult and DevTool Synergy are seeing a lot of demand from platform engineering teams looking for practical guidance on instrumenting LLMs in production. Sam and I were thinking a short, vendor-paired briefing series (30–40 min) aimed at senior platform leads would land well — high-signal demos, 10 minutes for Q&A, and a follow-up playbook.

Would Redwood be interested in co-running a three-part pilot (intro + ops patterns + cost/perf tradeoffs) early December? OpsConsult would handle outreach to our devops cohort and provide a short post-event whitepaper. We can put together a draft agenda and speaker slate if you’re game.

Attached: one-pager concept.

Best,
Samir
Co-founder, DevTool Synergy

Samir —

Appreciate the concept — sounds like exactly the kind of partner-led content we want. Marissa and Ben are copied; Marissa can take point on content & slides, Ben will coordinate the field outreach and invite list.

A few quick asks from our side so we scope properly:
- Target audience: platform engineering leads (IC + manager); aim to keep it technical, not marketing.
- Goal: 250 signups, 90 live attendees, and a gated playbook.
- Timing: Prefer week of Dec 8–12 for session 1, with weekly cadence after.

Can you send a tentative agenda and any proposed speaker bios? We’ll run a short internal approvals sprint once we have that.

Thanks — I’ll block some time for a quick triage sync later today.

— Rishi
